items.why: Moving with the AI bounce lifting stocks today, as midday coverage notes SpaceX helping lift AI plays and tech rallying ahead of Meta earnings.
SpaceX shares surging on Tesla deal talks is the day's big story, and Tesla is climbing on the same news with the Nasdaq up over 1%.
Riding the broader tech rally, with the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all gaining on earnings optimism and AI names bouncing.
Slipping as Alphabet opts out of tokenized stocks in what coverage calls a blow to the plan from OKK and the NYSE parent.

market_note: Futures green into the close; VIX down nearly 4% as earnings cheer supports stocks.
summary: The Nasdaq is up over 1% and the VIX is down nearly 4% as earnings optimism lifts tech. AI names are the biggest winners while Alphabet slips on the tokenized-stocks opt-out.
